chapters.title: Maraudon full clear and local rewards
sequence: Outside the instance, take Legends of Maraudon7044 from Cavindra. Kill the Nameless Prophet, obtain the Amulet of Spirits and deal with the three exterior khans. Fill Vark's vial at the orange entrance pool.
Enter orange. Complete the Vylestem/scion objective, kill Noxxion for the Celebrian Rod, and handle the orange-wing khan.
Detour through purple for Lord Vyletongue's Celebrian Diamond and the purple-wing khan. Combine all five gems for The Pariah's Instructions.
Kill Celebras the Cursed. Turn in Legends, accept The Scepter of Celebras7046, and finish the ritual before leaving the junction.
In inner Maraudon, collect An'she's crystal beside Landslide on every eligible character. Kill Princess Theradras and take Seed of Life7066 from Zaetar's Spirit BEFORE dropping to the pool.
Kill Rotgrip and collect Earth Song Water from the splash beneath the eastern stone bridge. Check every player's crystal, water, amulet and Seed of Life before leaving.
Hand in Pariah, Vyletongue and Corruption to their Desolace givers. Return to Shen'dralas, use the water on the burning tree beside Woodwyrd, and turn in Rot and Regret.
Carry An'she's Radiance for the scheduled Mulgore return and Seed of Life for Moonglade. Neither delayed reward is counted in this chapter.
notes: This means both entrance wings plus the inner dungeon, not a Princess shortcut.
150 kills is a planning allowance for the entire run and exterior approach, not a measured clear count; do not add the same boss kills again.
Loot carvings and fragments if already doing their objectives, but no reset or extra farming is needed to make the XP model work.

If Ripple Recovery650 is unfinished and missing, take it from Malton Droffers after the short649introduction; skip its reward if already completed.

quests.objective: Explore the eastern and temple pylons, then speak to Mordent. Start at the western Shen’dralar Pylon.

quests.name: Powering the Pylons
